qa-crawler.description: QA coverage crawler engine (run `pnpm build` first). Point a run's browser.mode at `neko` to drive Neko over CDP. In another project, use the absolute path to dist/index.js.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP with auto browser selection: Neko over CDP when reachable (local 9223 or $QA_NEKO_CDP), else its own Chromium — headed with a display, headless without. $QA_BROWSER=launch forces local.
